findings.title: Fallback delivery claims message observation without observing it
findings.behavior: Host narration delivery acknowledgement and downstream commit gate
findings.evidence: sendMessage and slash branches at 79-86 always return observed:true, even when result is undefined and no message is added; they synthesize IDs. Memory repro with chat:[], sendMessage:async()=>undefined returned ok:true/observed:true/local-ID while chat.length stayed 0. update at 37-44 also returns observed:true after render and save failures because it compares only its own array mutation. index.js 685 wires this adapter into orchestration; commit-recovery.js 35 and 55-56 permit commit based on observed.
findings.risk: A host no-op/failed render can be reported as delivered, bypassing the project's explicit no-message/no-state-commit contract. Update repro proves weak evidence, not actual persisted loss in a real host.
findings.recommendation: Require a stable host message identity and read-back confirmation; return unconfirmed/observed:false for unknown API results. Separate array mutation, display confirmation and save result rather than treating them as one acknowledgement.
findings.verification: Add dedicated adapter tests for no-op/undefined send and slash, render/save failure, missing API, successful append/update and concurrent appends. Verify commit gate rejects absent/unconfirmed messages; then separately accept supported host APIs at runtime.

findings.title: Concurrent sampling overrides restore another call's temporary settings
findings.behavior: Overlapping Tavern quiet calls mutating shared chatCompletionSettings
findings.evidence: 53-69 saves current global settings independently and unconditionally restores each saved value. 496-511 applies this around an awaited generation without ownership/serialization. Coordinator-reverified pure-memory repro: initial temperature .7, A overrides .2, B overrides .9; A finishes first, then B, final temperature becomes .2 instead of .7. This continuation checked source; it did not rerun that supplied repro.
findings.risk: Overlapping module calls contaminate each other's sampling and leave the host's session settings changed after completion; later main generation may use unintended values. No settings-file persistence claimed.
findings.recommendation: Give temporary sampling one owner and serialize the full mutation/generation/restoration window, or use a verified host-supported per-call override without shared mutation.
findings.verification: Regression both completion orders, partial-overlap parameter sets, rejection/timeout/cancel and a main-generation overlap; original values must be restored exactly and other calls must not inherit temporary values.

findings.title: Quiet cancellation ends local bookkeeping but not the underlying generation
findings.behavior: Pre-aborted request and timeout/cancel quiet lifecycle
findings.evidence: generateQuietPrompt/generateRaw is invoked at 504 before withTimeout checks signal.aborted at 263. Quiet withTimeout call at 505 has no underlying cancellation callback; finally decrements busy and restores sampling at 509-511 even if generation remains unresolved. Coordinator-reverified pre-aborted repro observed generateQuietPrompt still started. Normal grace at 507 is skipped on rejection. index.js 277, 282 and 303 use isQuietBusy to classify host events. Retry sleep at 610 also does not subscribe to abort.
findings.risk: A cancelled request may still spend model work; late generation events can arrive after quiet busy becomes false and be treated as ordinary events. Actual late-event misclassification in installed SillyTavern is not runtime-reproduced here. Retry cancellation can wait until sleep ends.
findings.recommendation: Check abort before touching sampling or starting generation; bind supported cancellation to the actual quiet operation and retain ownership until it really settles. Make retry sleep abort-aware and distinguish request cancellation from underlying completion.
findings.verification: Pre-aborted input must launch zero generations; cancel/timeout a deferred quiet stub, deliver late events, and verify no ordinary-turn work/early sampling restore. Abort a long retry wait and require prompt rejection.

findings.title: Case-sensitive object merge does not override HTTP header names
findings.behavior: Preset Authorization header overriding generated authentication
findings.evidence: Generated OpenAI header is lowercase authorization at 534 (and 316 for model lists); extras use Object.assign at 294 or spread at 324. YAML/parser test explicitly accepts Authorization capitalization (api-presets.test.mjs 34-37). Actual createLlmClient with stub fetch and Authorization extra produced new Headers(options.headers).get('authorization') = 'Bearer default-test, Bearer override-test', not the override alone. Current override test only covers lowercase authorization at llm-client.test.mjs 625/633.
findings.risk: Common capitalized authorization override becomes a duplicate/comma-combined credential value and may be rejected by gateways. This is a correctness finding; no real key exposure or network request was observed.
findings.recommendation: Merge headers with case-insensitive semantics, e.g. Headers.set for extras, both completion and model-list paths; preserve documented last-writer-wins behavior.
findings.verification: Test Authorization/authorization/AUTHORIZATION plus mixed-case x-api-key and listModels; serialized wire-equivalent Headers must contain one effective value per logical header.

findings.title: YAML parsing accepts partial documents and silently changes flow values
findings.evidence:
parseYamlBlock discards parseBlock's consumed index at 197. Memory results: '{top_k: 20, top_p: 0.9}' => {top_k:'20, top_p: 0.9'}; 'stop: [a, b]' => {stop:'[a, b]'}; 'top_k: 20
junk
top_p: 0.9' => {top_k:20}. Thus unsupported or malformed tails are not rejected even though parse failure is documented to return null. Root flow object fallback at 179-181 recurses into a one-line scalar value instead of parsing commas.
findings.risk: UI shows configured values but requests silently omit parameters or send strings where numbers/arrays are intended; especially misleading under advertised Tavern-style YAML semantics.
findings.recommendation: Require full input consumption, reject unsupported shapes explicitly and surface a validation error, or use a maintained parser after an approved dependency gate. Do not silently interpret unsupported flow syntax as another type.
findings.verification: Fixtures for multi-key flow maps, nested flow arrays/maps, malformed trailing lines, continuation list-map items, escaped quotes/comments, scientific numeric notation and accepted documented subset; invalid inputs must never partially apply.

findings.title: Model-list request has no deadline and its UI supplies no cancellation
findings.evidence: listModels awaits fetch and response.json at 326-328 with only an optional caller signal; no timer/controller/deadline. index.js 3852 disables the button, calls listModels without a signal at 3855-3860 and only re-enables it in finally at 3884-3885. A never-settling fetch stub remained pending; the 25ms observation is not itself a timeout proof, missing deadline is source-proven.
findings.risk: A stalled gateway or body read leaves the model-discovery button disabled and status stuck indefinitely until the panel/page is recreated.
findings.recommendation: Apply a bounded configurable discovery deadline across headers and body; allow disposal/new-request cancellation and reset the UI deterministically.
findings.verification: Never-resolving fetch and json stubs must return a timeout status; cancellation/disposal must restore UI state and late responses must not update a replacement card.

findings.title: Empty write reports cleared even when clearing failed
findings.behavior: Idempotent injection cleanup and settings status
findings.evidence: clear at 75-76 returns status:failed on host failure. Empty write ignores that result at 85 and overwrites last with cleared:true at 86. Memory host accepted 'old' then threw on empty text: write({text:' '}) returned status:empty and inspect().last.cleared=true while host container still held 'old'. Existing tests separately check clear failure but not this composition.
findings.risk: Stale prompt text can survive while the UI reports successful cleanup, hiding that later generations may reuse old injection.
findings.recommendation: Propagate failed/unsupported clear and preserve uncleared metadata until the host clear succeeds; do not overwrite failure with an empty-success record.
findings.verification: Write nonempty text, fail the empty clear, assert failure/cleared:false and retained diagnostic; retry successful clear, then assert empty/cleared:true. Also test repeated clear idempotency.

findings.title: Installation guide names nested paths as current manifest targets
findings.evidence: INSTALL.md 17-22 says current manifest references nested index.js and host/style.css. Actual manifest.json 8 and 19 reference root index.js and style.css; root index is a forwarding module and package test verifies root/nested style equality.
findings.risk: Troubleshooting and release packaging can target the wrong files, though existing forwarding keeps installation layout functional.
findings.recommendation: Describe the actual root entry/style and separately document their modular implementation/backup relationship; preserve root templates and public loading paths.
findings.verification: Compare guide targets against parsed manifest and run extension-package.test.mjs plus settings-template test after any separately authorized documentation correction.
